patch_description:
The validation failure was caused by correctness problems in the recursive implementation rather than a useful reorder result. In particular, rows were written using completion-order indexes from `as_completed`, which can overwrite or misplace rows; temporary `original_index` handling and merges could alter row/value correspondence; the final sort ignored the generated ordering; and the method returned an empty column-ordering list even when values had been permuted.

The replacement keeps every original row and cell value, avoids unsafe threaded mutation, handles missing and mixed values only for scoring normalization, and returns valid per-row column orderings. It evaluates a bounded set of deterministic column-order candidates using the actual serialized-string Trie/LCP objective, including a global frequency ordering and a conditional grouping ordering.
